description: HAL USART1 115200 8N1: hello banner, 'tick N' every 1000 ms, interrupt-driven RX line echo
expect:
72 MHz, USART1 PA9/PA10 115200 8N1 (BRR 0x271, exact). First TX: 'Hello from STM32F103!
'. Then 'tick N
', N = 1, 2, ..., first bytes exactly 1000 ms apart (+-20 us; tick 1 starts 999-1000 ms after the banner) unless an echo is still being sent (no drift). RX via HAL_UART_Receive_IT, one byte at a time: CR or LF ends a line; a non-empty line is answered 'echo: <line>
' starting < 0.5 ms after its terminator (later only while another line is being sent). Empty lines are ignored (CRLF echoes once), lines keep their first 63 bytes, up to 4 lines queue, bytes with framing/noise/parity errors are dropped.

circuit: USART1: virtual terminal on PA9 (TX) / PA10 (RX)

scenarios.name: CRLF echoes once, LF alone also terminates
two lines back to back are both echoed in order
a long line keeps its first 63 bytes
